name: @teamshift/sandbox-mcp

tools.name: crm_search_contacts
tools.description: Find people by name, email, phone digits or title. Use before any contact-specific action to get the contact id. Set missingInfo to find contacts lacking a valid email or phone.

tools.name: crm_get_contact
tools.description: Full profile of one contact plus their customer account, leads, deals and recent calls. Use when you need context before replying to or changing a contact.

tools.name: crm_create_contact
tools.description: Add a new person, optionally linked to a customer account. Search first to avoid creating duplicates.

tools.name: crm_update_contact
tools.description: Change a contact's name, email, phone, title or customer link. Omitted fields stay as they are; null clears a field. Use to fix missing or malformed contact info.

tools.name: crm_merge_contacts
tools.description: Fold a duplicate contact (mergeId) into the one to keep (keepId): empty fields are filled from the duplicate, all leads/deals/messages/calls are re-pointed, and the duplicate is deleted. Irreversible; confirm they are the same person first.

tools.name: crm_list_customers
tools.description: List customer accounts (households or businesses), newest first. Filter by text, status or owner.

tools.name: crm_get_customer
tools.description: One customer account with its contacts, deals, jobs and invoices. Use for a full account picture.

tools.name: crm_list_employees
tools.description: Active staff with ids and roles. Use to pick an owner for a deal/lead or an assignee for a job or task.

tools.name: crm_list_leads
tools.description: Inbound leads, newest first. Set uncontacted: true to find leads nobody has responded to yet.

tools.name: crm_update_lead
tools.description: Change a lead's status or owner. Note: sending an email/SMS or logging an outbound call to the lead's contact marks it contacted automatically.

tools.name: crm_list_deals
tools.description: Sales pipeline deals, most recently updated first. Use staleDays to find open deals with no activity for N days, openOnly to skip won/lost.

tools.name: crm_get_deal
tools.description: One deal with its quotes and contact.

tools.name: crm_update_deal
tools.description: Move a deal to a new stage and/or set its next action, amount or owner. Stage moves must follow the pipeline (new→qualified→quote-sent→negotiation→won/lost; won is final; lost can reopen). Moving to lost requires lostReason. Set nextAction to {summary, dueOn} so every open deal has a next step.

amountCents.description: Deal value in integer cents, e.g. 12500 = $125.00

tools.name: crm_list_quotes
tools.description: Quotes/estimates. Set notFollowedUp: true to find sent quotes that never got a follow-up.

tools.name: crm_send_quote
tools.description: Send a draft quote to the customer (status becomes sent). Only works on drafts.

tools.name: crm_follow_up_quote
tools.description: Message the deal's contact about a sent/viewed quote and record the follow-up on the quote. Write the full message body. Goes to the outbox; nothing is really delivered.

employeeId.description: Sender; defaults to the company address

tools.name: crm_list_tasks
tools.description: To-dos for staff. Filter by status, assignee or a related record id.

tools.name: crm_create_task
tools.description: Create a to-do for a staff member, linked to the records it is about (relatedIds). Use when a human must do something you cannot.

tools.name: crm_complete_task
tools.description: Mark an open task done.

tools.name: inbox_list_threads
tools.description: Email and SMS conversations, newest activity first, with unread counts and the last message snippet. Use unreadOnly to triage.

tools.name: inbox_get_thread
tools.description: All messages in one thread, oldest first. Read before replying.

tools.name: inbox_send_email
tools.description: Send an email to a contact, raw address, or as a reply in an existing thread (threadId). Subject is required for new threads. Written to the outbox only; nothing leaves the sandbox.

employeeId.description: Sender; defaults to the company address

tools.name: inbox_send_sms
tools.description: Send a text message to a contact, raw number, or within an SMS thread. Outbox only.

tools.name: inbox_mark_thread_read
tools.description: Mark every message in a thread as read after handling it.

tools.name: calendar_list_jobs
tools.description: Scheduled work (appointments / work orders / projects), latest start first. Filter by status, customer, assignee, or a start-time window [from, to).

tools.name: calendar_get_job
tools.description: One job with its customer and invoices.

tools.name: calendar_schedule_job
tools.description: Book new work for a customer. Assignees must be active employees and not double-booked (pass allowOverlap to override).

tools.name: calendar_reschedule_job
tools.description: Move a scheduled or no-show job to a new time window (optionally new assignees). Does NOT notify the customer; send them a message separately if policy requires.

tools.name: calendar_cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled or in-progress job. Requires a reason. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: calendar_complete_job
tools.description: Mark a scheduled or in-progress job completed now, with optional notes.

tools.name: invoicing_list_invoices
tools.description: Invoices, newest first. Set overdue: true for unpaid invoices past their due date.

tools.name: invoicing_get_invoice
tools.description: One invoice with its payments and balance due.

tools.name: invoicing_create_invoice
tools.description: Issue an invoice to a customer (optionally for a job of that customer). Total is computed from line items; due date defaults to company payment terms.

tools.name: invoicing_send_reminder
tools.description: Send a payment reminder for an open or partially-paid invoice to the customer's contact (outbox only). A default polite body is used if none is given.

tools.name: invoicing_void_invoice
tools.description: Void an invoice that has no payments applied (e.g. issued against the wrong job). Irreversible; requires a reason.

tools.name: invoicing_record_payment
tools.description: Record money received against an invoice. Cannot exceed the balance; void, draft and paid invoices are rejected.

amountCents.description: Amount received in integer cents, e.g. 12500 = $125.00

tools.name: invoicing_list_payments
tools.description: Payments received, newest first. Set unmatched: true for payments not yet applied to any invoice.

tools.name: invoicing_match_payment
tools.description: Apply an unmatched payment to the invoice it pays. Customer must match and amount must not exceed the balance.

tools.name: phone_list_calls
tools.description: Phone call log, newest first. Use outcome: missed and direction: inbound to find calls that may need a callback.

tools.name: phone_log_call
tools.description: Record a call you made or took (e.g. a callback), with outcome and a short summary. No real call is placed.

tools.name: admin_get_company_policies
tools.description: The company's plain-language operating rules (response times, follow-up cadence, payment terms...). Read before acting.

tools.name: admin_get_company
tools.description: Company profile plus the simulated current time and today's date in company time.

tools.name: admin_get_audit_log
tools.description: Every mutation attempted so far (tool, input, ok/error, changed ids), in order. Use sinceSeq to fetch only newer entries.

tools.name: admin_reset
tools.description: Restore the original dataset and clock, discarding every change. The audit log is kept and records the reset.

tools.name: admin_save_state
tools.description: Write the current dataset, audit log and outbox to the --state-out file for grading.

tools.name: admin_advance_clock
tools.description: Move simulated time forward by N minutes (e.g. to simulate waiting for a reply).

instructions: You are operating the business systems of Copper Kettle Plumbing & Air, a fictional small business (Residential HVAC and plumbing: repairs, replacements and maintenance plans; timezone America/Chicago, currency USD). Everything is simulated and offline: sending email or SMS only writes to an outbox. Money is always integer cents. Read sandbox://policies (or call admin_get_company_policies) before acting, look records up before changing them, and prefer the most specific tool.
